key.name: freeze-ocr
key.summary: Freeze the screen and select text from the frozen frame

key.name: glow-enabled
key.summary: Show an animated gradient glow around the screen edge while frozen
key.description: Qotirish rejimiga kirilgani ko'rinib turishi uchun ekran chetida gradient halqa yonadi: o'qilayotganda sariq va tez, belgilashga tayyor bo'lganda ko'k-siyoh va sokin, xatoda qizil. Faqat opacity animatsiyasi ishlatiladi, lekin juda sust grafikada o'chirish mumkin.

key.name: ocr-languages
key.summary: Tesseract language codes for screen OCR, joined by +
key.description: Mavjud tillar: eng, rus, uzb, uzb_cyrl, osd. Ko'p til qo'shilsa OCR sekinlashadi, shuning uchun faqat kerakli tillar yoziladi.
